instruments.grantee: The Marine Midland Trust Company of New York and Baldwin Maull, Trustees
instruments.mortgagee: The Marine Midland Trust Company of New York and Baldwin Maull, Trustees
instruments.other_capacities: Trustees for holders of First Mortgage Sinking Fund Bonds, 4%, Series A, due March 1, 1956
instruments.legal_description_raw: Statewide and multistate mortgage of company real estate, compressor and measuring stations, gas pipe lines, transmission lines, rights-of-way, easements, gas-distribution systems, oil-and-gas leasehold estates and mineral interests, contracts, franchises, equipment, and after-acquired property. The Beckham County rights-of-way schedule includes B. E. Maddoux — N/2 NW/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West; A. E. Maddoux — S/2 NW/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West; and G. A. Crook — NE/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West.
instruments.legal_description_normalized: Pipeline rights-of-way/easements across N/2 NW/4, S/2 NW/4, and NE/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West
instruments.prior_references: The indenture references company deeds, leases, rights-of-way, permits, franchises, and contracts itemized in its schedules, including the three separately recorded target rights-of-way at B05-G011 through B05-G013.
instruments.subject_to: Secures First Mortgage Sinking Fund Bonds, including 4% Series A bonds due March 1, 1956; trust terms, redemption provisions, and prior property burdens stated in the indenture.
instruments.consideration: $10.00 and other good and valuable consideration
instruments.material_title_notes: Complete replacement record for the Batch 05 partial B05-G017 extraction. The indenture begins on 0223.jpg (Mortgage Book 64 p.507), contains the target Beckham County right-of-way schedule on 0243.jpg, and continues without interruption through 0300.jpg (p.584). Scoped pages 0251.jpg-0273.jpg continue grantor/land, permit, and pipeline-system schedules; 0274.jpg-0293.jpg continue distribution-system, oil-and-gas leasehold/mineral-interest, franchise, contract, and additional-property schedules; 0294.jpg-0300.jpg contain granting, trust, definition, bond, and additional-bond provisions. Overlap-only inspection of 0301.jpg (p.585) confirms the same indenture continues, so no execution, acknowledgment, or actual recorded ending page is claimed.
instruments.interest_before: Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation held its operating properties, pipeline and distribution systems, leasehold/mineral interests, contracts, franchises, and easement/right-of-way interests, including the three target Section 32 easements.
instruments.interest_after: The company properties and rights were pledged/mortgaged to The Marine Midland Trust Company of New York and Baldwin Maull, Trustees, as bond collateral; this created a continuing lien/security conveyance rather than transferring the fee or operating ownership to a successor.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: Directly relevant because the mortgage schedule identifies all three target Section 32 pipeline-easement tracts. No Diversified party appears, and this security instrument alone does not establish corporate succession or a later conveyance to Diversified.
instruments.assumptions: County-book pages are continuous from page 507 on 0223.jpg through page 584 on 0300.jpg. The target aliquots on compressed 0243.jpg are corroborated by the complete rights-of-way at B05-G011 through B05-G013. The instrument remains partial because overlap-only 0301.jpg is page 585 of the same indenture; no unobserved ending, signatures, or acknowledgment were inferred.
instruments.full_title: Indenture of Mortgage and Deed of Trust (partial through 0300.jpg)

assumptions_and_gaps.field_affected: prior-batch replacement, actual instrument ending, and acknowledgment
assumptions_and_gaps.assumption_made: This consolidated record completely replaces the Batch 05 partial extraction and preserves B05-G017 and its original 0223.jpg start. It extends the reviewed instrument range through 0300.jpg but leaves the actual ending page and acknowledgment blank because the indenture continues.
assumptions_and_gaps.basis: All 50 scoped images were opened and visually inspected. Recorded pages run continuously from 535 on 0251.jpg through 584 on 0300.jpg, and overlap-only 0301.jpg is page 585 continuing Article 3 without a new caption, execution block, signature, or acknowledgment.
assumptions_and_gaps.recommended_follow_up: Use this B05-G017 record as a replacement, not an additional instrument. Carry it into Batch 07 and replace it again when the execution, acknowledgment, and true ending page are visually located.
